description: See a flow and run its stages from the sidebar.
view.name: Flows
config.cliPath: Path to the Flowgit CLI. When empty, the extension looks in the workspace node_modules/.bin and then on PATH. It never downloads a CLI.
untrusted.description: In Restricted Mode the sidebar and CodeLens stay visible, but Flowgit will not run commands. Trust the workspace to run a stage, run all stages, open the board, compare versions, or confirm a copied flow.
